The verses of the first Buddhist nuns, among the oldest poems by women anywhere, translated from the Pali with the stories of their lives.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Psalms of the early Buddhists I. Psalms of the sisters [tr. from the Therigatha] · Davids, Caroline A. F. Rhys (Caroline Augusta Foley Rhys), 1857-1942 · 1909, 268 scanned pages. Published 1909; Caroline A. F. Rhys Davids died 1942; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
